primary_metric: All four different-value siblings answered correctly by unrestricted greedy decoding; also report individual-answer accuracy.
requirements: Verify executable truth and every registered token mask before inference.
Keep original input/positions and ordinary hybrid prefix processing; block every record-KV column only for question/answer rows, including cached scoring and generation.
Inspect actual blocked softmax probabilities and nonzero full-history controls at all six attention layers on sampled contexts, and verify prefix/historical-KV identity.
Audit raw free-generation correctness and complete four-sibling families for both splits/conditions; do not treat 25-percent per-answer lookup as evidence of memory use.
interpretation: Immediate single-fact carrier/readout positive control, not a long-memory or semantic-update result. Within each family only three value-token IDs differ; question text, token positions, all other input IDs and allowed history columns match. A deterministic prefix-independent answer can get at most one of four siblings correct. Retained carriers include recurrent/convolution state built with normal hybrid prefix attention.
